accelPrivateRepoDesc: Off = no more prompts, and no acceleration (token never leaves the device)
accelPrivateWarnTitle: Accelerating private repos: your token will leave this device
accelPrivateWarnBody: Files in a private repo can only be fetched with a token (the raw endpoint has no signing mechanism). Once enabled, this app hands that token to the acceleration channel, which then requests GitHub on your behalf. This differs from the built-in channel promise that the token never leaves your device.
accelPrivateWarnPoint1: Measured: the built-in channel forwards the token to GitHub verbatim (200 with token / 404 without)
accelPrivateWarnPoint2: The token reaches a third-party server; its retention and use are outside this project's control
accelPrivateWarnPoint3: You can turn this off in Settings at any time; doing so returns to "no acceleration" with no exceptions kept
accelPrivateWarnAccept: I understand the risk, enable anyway
accelAddHint: A third-party service you must vet yourself; the address must be https://
accelScopesHint: Prefix-style proxies expose only a limited set of endpoints (one may forward release assets but not in-repo images). Enable acceleration only for the kinds you actually need; leave the rest on a direct connection.
webSectionDesc: Options that exist only in the browser
webInstallPrompt: Ask to add to home screen on launch
webInstallPromptDesc: Asked once each time the page is opened; skipped once the app is installed (opened from its own icon).
